svg.title: Graphical abstract
svg.desc: Graphical abstract: sample reads and matched AID-null controls from nanopore, Sanger or Illumina sequencing are analyzed by SHMtrace, which suppresses background, agrees with Sanger and adds clones and trees.

tspan.tspan: reads: each candidate mutation tested against
the errors of matched AID-null libraries
Sanger clones: counted against that background
